title: AI Workflow Automation Specialist: Multi-Jurisdiction Document Parsing
description:
We are a small business looking to automate a tedious document-processing task. Currently, our team manually extracts review comments from various jurisdiction documents and copies them into our company’s standardized Word (.docx) response template. We process approximately 5–10 forms per month. However, because we work across multiple jurisdictions, the incoming files arrive in varying formats: some are PDFs, some are Word documents, and others are Excel spreadsheets. The layout is highly consistent within each specific jurisdiction, but varies between different jurisdictions.

We want an expert to build a low-code/no-code AI automation pipeline (using Gumloop, Make.com, or Zapier Central) to handle this workflow seamlessly.

Scope of Work:
1. File Ingestion: Detect when a new review document is uploaded to our cloud storage [Insert your storage, e.g., Google Drive / OneDrive].
2. Jurisdiction Identification & Routing: The system must read the document header, identify which jurisdiction it came from, and apply the correct parsing rules.
3. AI Text Extraction: Utilize an LLM (via OpenAI/Anthropic API) paired with robust document-parsing to cleanly isolate the reviewer comments—filtering out legal boilerplate, headers, and irrelevant text. This must handle PDFs (OCR), Word files, and Excel tables.
4. Template Mapping: Inject the extracted comments accurately into our company's standardized .docx template using specific placeholder tags.
5. Output Delivery: Save the newly populated Word template into a designated "Completed" folder and alert the team.

What We Will Provide to Shortlisted Candidates:
• Clean sample files of incoming documents from 3 different jurisdictions (PDF, Word, and Excel formats).
• Our blank company Word template showing exactly where text needs to go.
• An example of a finalized, correctly formatted document so you can see the expected end result.

Requirements:
• Proven experience building document-parsing workflows using Gumloop, Make.com, or Zapier.
• Strong understanding of leveraging LLM APIs (OpenAI GPT-4o / Anthropic Claude) for structured data extraction from unstructured text.
• Ability to build clean, conditional logic branches based on document content.
• Excellent communication skills and a willingness to provide a brief 10-minute video walkthrough of how the system works upon completion.
